# API Reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Search

Corpus search and concordancing

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [search.SearchResults](search.SearchResults.qmd#polars_corpus.search.SearchResults) | Results of a corpus search query. |
| [search.concordance](search.concordance.qmd#polars_corpus.search.concordance) | Generate a concordance from search results (functional interface). |
| [search.collocates](search.collocates.qmd#polars_corpus.search.collocates) | Extract collocate frequency information from search results. |
| [matcher.search](matcher.search.qmd#polars_corpus.matcher.search) | Search corpus using simple query language (BNCweb-style). |
| [matcher.search_cqp](matcher.search_cqp.qmd#polars_corpus.matcher.search_cqp) | Search corpus using a CQP-style query. |
| [matcher.get_matches](matcher.get_matches.qmd#polars_corpus.matcher.get_matches) | Parse query and retrieve matching spans |

## Association Measures

Collocation and co-occurrence statistics

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [assoc.crosstab](assoc.crosstab.qmd#polars_corpus.assoc.crosstab) | Create a crosstabulation (contingency table) from two categorical variables. |
| [assoc.pmi](assoc.pmi.qmd#polars_corpus.assoc.pmi) | Compute Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) for contingency table data. |
| [assoc.loglik](assoc.loglik.qmd#polars_corpus.assoc.loglik) | Compute log-likelihood ratio (G²) statistic for contingency table data. |
| [assoc.minsens](assoc.minsens.qmd#polars_corpus.assoc.minsens) | Compute minimum sensitivity values for contingency table data. |
| [assoc.welchs_t](assoc.welchs_t.qmd#polars_corpus.assoc.welchs_t) | Perform Welch's t-test for equality of two independent samples with unequal variances. |

## Lexical Diversity

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [lexical.ttr](lexical.ttr.qmd#polars_corpus.lexical.ttr) | Calculate type-token ratio (TTR). |
| [lexical.msttr](lexical.msttr.qmd#polars_corpus.lexical.msttr) | Calculate mean segmental type-token ratio (MSTTR). |
| [lexical.mtld](lexical.mtld.qmd#polars_corpus.lexical.mtld) | Calculate Measure of Textual Lexical Diversity (MTLD). |
| [lexical.yules_k](lexical.yules_k.qmd#polars_corpus.lexical.yules_k) | Calculate Yule's K characteristic. |
